project_type: Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript + React 19 + Bun
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, setup in vitest.setup.ts, tests in lib/__tests__/
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run type-check to verify no TS errors. 2. Run bun run test:run to verify tests pass.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. No database available for integration tests - mock DB repos in tests. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: Use createApiHandler for all API routes. Use Zod schemas for validation. Use audit logging for mutations. Use cache invalidation for mutations.
key_patterns: createApiHandler wraps all routes with auth, validation, rate limiting, error handling. Handler signature: (req: NextRequest, context: ApiContext) => Promise<NextResponse>. Context has requestId, userId, params, tracker. Response helpers: successResponse, errorResponse, paginatedResponse. getPaginationParams extracts page/limit/offset from URL. Repos return arrays for list ops and single items for get ops. noUncheckedIndexedAccess means array destructuring needs null checks.
directory_structure: app/api/ - API routes (Next.js App Router). lib/ - shared code. lib/db/repositories/ - DB CRUD. lib/middleware/ - API wrappers. lib/validation/ - Zod schemas. lib/cache/ - Redis caching. lib/auth/ - Authentication. lib/__tests__/ - test files.
